# About this guide {.unnumbered}

This book is for people who write content for the course fork of *Think Python* (3rd edition) at
<https://github.com/y-rosenthal/yrThinkPython>. The fork's website is
<https://y-rosenthal.github.io/yrThinkPython/>.

Read the next chapter, **Content Author Guide**, before you edit anything. Most of it is about the
"Prof. Rosenthal's Review" pages: how to add a question, which parts you type, and which parts the
tools write for you.

To build this book:

```bash
cd author-guide
quarto render          # the HTML goes to author-guide/_book/ (not committed)
quarto preview         # or: open a live preview in the browser
```

The source of each rule is the repository itself. If this guide and the repository disagree, the
repository is correct: `yr/README.md` for the review pages, and the files in `.claude/skills/` for
the other tasks.
